name: osmaza-plugin-test-marketplace
description: Test marketplace used to verify Claude Code plugin distribution end to end.

plugins.name: test-lab
plugins.description: Seven probe skills that each verify a different plugin mechanism: skill loading, bundled reference files, bundled scripts, update propagation, sync completeness, a combined selftest, and a bundled changelog.

plugins.name: test-lab-2
plugins.description: Second probe plugin in the same marketplace. Verifies that a new plugin appears in an already-added catalogue, and that two plugins coexist without colliding.
